visual_anchors: two men walking in close proximity
symbolic_mapping: proximity as co-presence in shared social space
philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: The image captures a moment of non-verbal coordination between individuals, illustrating how social existence is enacted through synchronized movement and spatial negotiation rather than explicit interaction.
alternative_interpretations: They may simply be strangers coincidentally walking at the same pace without awareness of each other.
limitations: No facial expressions, eye contact, or gestures confirm intentionality of proximity.

alternative_interpretations: The image may have been taken in winter for practical reasons unrelated to symbolism.
limitations: Season cannot be definitively established from tree silhouette alone without leaf detail.

symbolic_mapping: clothing as external signifier of role or status
